evidence.reason: The function is intended to expand systemd %i/%I specifiers for dependency scanning. systemd defines %i as the escaped instance and %I as the unescaped instance; line 177 substitutes the same escaped instance for both. For an instance like `crq\x2dtick`, a `Service=%I.service` reference therefore becomes `crq\x2dtick.service` instead of the real `crq-tick.service`, hiding the dependency edge. This is an implementation error in existing intended behavior; apply unit-name unescaping only for %I and leave %i unchanged.
